name: Full-bleed roofing hero, parallax image + staggered headline
notes: Fixed-position hero image creates a parallax effect as the page scrolls under it (JS toggles .is-past once scrolled out of the viewport — not included here, degrades gracefully to a static bg). Headline lines and CTAs fade/slide in via .intro-in class added on load; .no-js fallback keeps everything visible with no JS. Image is a shared library placeholder (assets/placeholders/exterior-home.jpg) — swap in the target site's own photo before shipping.
